component.name: Soul State
component.summary: Mindful habits, finances, and nourishment — private and offline

description.p: Soul State is an offline-first private life operating system that unifies habit tracking, expense and income records, nutrition logs, Markdown vault sync, and encrypted S3 cloud storage.
No accounts, no subscriptions, no ads, no tracking. Every habit and setting stays on your computer, and the full source is open.

ul.li: Mindful habit tracking with daily streaks, flexible intervals, and activity heatmaps
Comprehensive personal finance tracking with category breakdowns
Daily meal, nutrition, and calorie logging
Soul State Vault: seamless Markdown synchronization compatible with Obsidian and Logseq
Automated S3 cloud backup with client-side AES-256 encryption
